paper_title: RLHF Workflow From Reward Modeling to Online RLHF
caption: The training record of reward modeling. From the left to right, we present the records of training loss, gradient norm, and the learning rate, respectively.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the training loss of a reward model over the course of 1400 training steps. The x-axis, labeled “Training Step,” spans from 0 to 1400 with linear scaling and tick marks at intervals of 200. The y-axis, labeled “Training Loss,” ranges from approximately 0.25 to 0.75, also on a linear scale, with grid lines at intervals of 0.1. A single blue solid line, marked in the legend as “Training Loss of Reward Model,” begins near 0.75 at step 0, drops sharply to around 0.4 by step 100, and then gradually decreases with oscillations to approximately 0.3 by step 1400. The line exhibits high-frequency noise throughout, particularly after step 200, indicating fluctuations in loss during later training stages. No other lines or data series are present in this plot.
